executive_summary.overview: Bajaj Auto Ltd. demonstrates a commitment to ethical conduct and employee well-being, as evidenced by its comprehensive policies and initiatives. However, there are areas of potential risk, particularly in supply chain compliance and gender representation in leadership roles.
executive_summary.key_finding: While Bajaj Auto has robust policies and practices for employee well-being and ethical conduct, there is a need for greater transparency and monitoring of human rights and environmental practices within its value chain partners.

safety_systems_status.evidence_snippet: All our plants are certified with ISO 45001:2018 by M/S Bureau Veritas.

accident_records_status.evidence_snippet: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) (per one million-person hours worked) | Workers | 0.08

audit_scores_status.evidence_snippet: We have implemented several proactive measures to ensure workplace safety.

collective_bargaining_status.evidence_snippet: This is exemplified by the timely signing of the Long-Term Wage Settlement at the Waluj plant.

leave_policy_status.evidence_snippet: Privilege leave entitlements are recognised as a liability, in the calendar year of rendering of service, as per the rules of the Company.

retirement_benefits_status.evidence_snippet: Payment for present liability of future payment of gratuity is being made to approved gratuity fund

healthcare_welfare_status.evidence_snippet: employees have access to state-of-the-art health and sports facilities.

due_diligence.evidence_snippet: We have a well-defined methodology, practices, and Supplier Code of Conduct (SCoC) to engage with all our suppliers in an ethical, responsible, fair, transparent, legal, and sustainable way.

forced_labor_policies.evidence_snippet: human rights are an essential part of supplier code of conduct.

supply_chain_compliance.principal_employer_liability: The company has a grievance redressal mechanism for workers, including contract workers, and ensures compliance with labour laws by its value chain partners.

business_impact.operational_efficiency: Employee engagement and skill development initiatives contribute to a positive work environment and improved productivity.
business_impact.financial_performance: Investment in R&D and sustainable practices can lead to cost savings and enhanced financial performance.
business_impact.brand_reputation: Ethical conduct and social responsibility enhance brand reputation and stakeholder trust.
business_impact.innovation_rnd: A diverse and skilled workforce fosters innovation and supports R&D efforts.

recommendations: Enhance monitoring and reporting of human rights and environmental practices within the supply chain.
Increase female representation in leadership positions to promote gender diversity.
Strengthen engagement with value chain partners to ensure compliance with ethical and sustainability standards.
Continue investing in employee well-being and skill development programs to foster a positive and productive work environment.

supply_chain_profile.key_metrics: Adherence to Supplier Code of Conduct
